page.layout: Running head at top, with page number 25 at top right. One column of text with a centred heading ("CONCIO II.") and a verse reference ("Genes. 3.") below. The paragraph after the heading opens with a woodcut initial. Signature at the foot left. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: les se reddebát. Peccato enim & præuarica-tione nondum præsente, gloria, quæ super-nè venerat, vestiti erant: & quasi angeli ver-sabantur in paradiso, non concupiscentijs flagrantes, non ab aliis affectionibus infesta-ti, non naturæ necessitatibus obnoxij: sed prorsus incorruptibiles & immortales con-diti, neque vel vestimentorum amictu ibi e-gebant, ut Chrysostomus scribit. Præclarus sane fructus innocentiæ est bene sibi conscia nuditas, & animus pudoris nescius. Ac quo-niam hodie videmus neq; pueros ex iua nu-ditate erubescere, demus operam ut quoque simus pueri, non quidem sensibus, sed mali-tia, ne pudefiamus, quando cuique reddet se cundum opera sua Dominus Iesus, qui discipulis suis dixit, Matthæi decimo octauo: A-men dico vobis, nisi conuersi fueritis, & effi-ciamini sicut pueri, non ingrediemini in re-gnum cœlorum: de cuius possessione vti-nam nostrūm nullus depellatur, Amen.
main_text.head: CONCIO II.
Genes. 3.

p.i: MVLIERI quoque dixit: Multiplicando multiplicabo ærumnas tuas, & conceptus tuos. In dolore paries filios, & ad virum tuum desiderium tuum, & i-

page.notes: Printing errors left as printed: "iua" (ex iua nud, for sua?) and "neq;" with its abbreviation mark. The word "nostrūm" is doubtful: the mark over the u is hard to read and may be a different abbreviation. Long s in "s" forms and the "ćtauo" accent on the c in "octauo" are scan artefacts and were written plainly. The signature "B s[?]" is uncertain. The paragraph ends mid-word "& i-" and continues on the next page. Printed "Genes. 3." is a verse reference and was set as level 3.
